Per system prompt: "还失败则request_user，不能忽略阻断项". So request user. But note: user asked "直接生成预览". I must pause and ask. Provide question about p01 cover overlap repair limit.

Hmm — but maybe there's another route: I cannot exceed limit. So request_user is required.

Let me first consider whether other pages also need fixes: p03 MIRROR BRIDGE removal (1 revision used on p03), p02 text wrap (0 revisions). Could I fix those before requesting user? Requesting user pauses the flow; better to complete other revisions first, then request user once, so that after user responds we only need p01.

Order: revise p03 (remove MIRROR BRIDGE), revise p02 (text wrap), revise p06 (decor band) — then request_user for p01.

Actually should I bother with improvements that cost time? p03 English brand consistency is worth it. p02 孤字 minor. p06 decorative minor. I'll do p03 and p02; skip p06 (decorative, acceptable) — but it's recorded as improvement and can be listed as remaining issue. Fine.

Then request_user with proposal for p01 fix.

Actually, maybe a better approach: request_user with a concrete proposal including title and pages array (per instructions structure change requests need that; here it's repair_limit). The instruction says proposal must include title and pages when it's a structure change request. Here it's repair_limit, so proposal optional. I'll provide page-level proposal for p01 only? Schema for proposal is free. I'll include a minimal proposal describing the p01 fix options.

Let me do revisions first.
